shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile with legs/paws indicated
low-relief carving on a dressed stone surface
animal figure raised against a plain flat ground
excavation context with earth and stones around the carved block
justification: Both show a profile quadruped with schematically bent, splayed limbs rendered in shallow relief standing out from an otherwise blank dressed stone face, and both are photographed in situ amid rubble. The decisive difference is compositional density: A carries a single isolated creature across an empty panel, while B is a crowded multi-register programme with a row of animals, a horizontal patterned band, further beasts and a large bird stacked below.
